newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's ColMut declines comment on report.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's ColMut declines comment on report.

text.p: Insurance and banking group Colonial Ltd said on Friday it had no comment on a newspaper report that it was about to buy out its Asian joint venture partner Jardine Pacific Holdings for more than A$200 million.
Jardine Pacific is a subsidiary of Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd. "It's just market speculation. We don't comment on market speculation," Colonial spokesman Simon Morgan said.

Earlier The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper said sources in Hong Kong had revealed that the joint venture company, Jardine-CMG Life Holdings, would become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Colonial under the deal.
Jardine-CMG owns life insurance businesses in Hong Kong, the Philippines and Singapore.
"It is believed details of the purchase will be announced in Hong Kong next week by the (Colonial Mutual) group's managing director Peter Smedley," the newspaper said.
Colonial Mutual, which currently has a mutual structure, is due to demutualise and list on the stock exchange in the first half of this year.
The group plans to distribute A$1.3 billion in shares to its 538,000 members worldwide, and raise another A$550 million, as part of its demutualisation and listing.
